## [3.46.0] - 2026-07-06

### Features

- enhance loyalty program logic with per-line exclusions and mutual exclusions handling
- add logo loading functionality for receipt printing in quotation dialog
- add daily sale report functionality with PDF download support
- update database schema to version 86 and enhance migration strategy for missing tables and columns
- implement auto-refresh for reports screen with cached data handling

### Bug Fixes

- update version format and compatibility checks for Odoo addon versioning
